Interviewer: Anthony Brown with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 79 pp.
You can say whatever you like.

Today is May 15th, 1994. This is the Smithsonian Institution Jazz Oral History Program interview with Roy Haynes in his home in Roosevelt, Long Island, New York. Mr. Haynes, if we could start by you stating your full name, your birth date, and place of birth, please.
